conditions.description: Applications must be made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary organisation in the academic or non-academic sector.
European Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to researchers of any nationality (no nationality restriction applies to the EF sub-type).
Global Postdoctoral Fellowships are restricted to European nationals or long-term residents (as defined in eligibility conditions at the end of the Work Programme part).
European Fellowships must take place in an EU Member State or a Horizon Europe Associated Country.
Global Fellowship outgoing phase must take place at an organisation in a Third Country not associated to Horizon Europe.
Global Fellowship mandatory return phase must be at a host organisation based in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country. Duration is 12 months.
European Fellowship standard duration must be between 12 and 24 months.

Global Fellowship total duration: outgoing phase minimum 12 and maximum 24 months, plus mandatory 12-month return phase, yielding a total of 24–36 months. Maximum project duration per selected_call.json is 36 months.

Non-academic placement must be at an organisation from the non-academic sector established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country. If the fellow is recruited in the non-academic sector, the placement must be at a different non-academic host organisation.
conditions.source_section: Scope – Placements in the non-academic sector

conditions.description: Eligible countries are described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes. A number of non-EU/non-Associated Countries have made specific provisions for funding their participants in Horizon Europe projects.

Specific eligibility conditions apply to MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships in research areas covered by the Euratom Research and Training Programme (described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes).
Financial and operational capacity conditions are described in Annex C of the Work Programme General Annexes.

Budget regime is unit_cost. Indicative call budget is EUR 59,857,539 for 2026. No explicit per-project min/max contribution is stated in the call entry (min_contribution and max_contribution are both 0.0 in the source).
